title: Consolidate SIG/CAIQ responses and standardized customer attestations for pricing tiers
creator: Anita Lopez
description: Goal: Create a single authoritative SIG/CAIQ response bundle and a set of tiered customer attestation templates that map to Redwood pricing/packaging tiers. This reduces sales cycles, ensures consistent legal posture across deals, and enables automated artifact generation for self-serve and sales-assisted flows. Scope: inventory existing responses, reconcile conflicts between engineering artifacts and legal guidance, produce a canonical CAIQ answer pack (v1) plus three attestation templates (Self-Serve, Dedicated, Private) with agreed scoping language. Deliverables: canonical CAIQ JSON+PDF, three attestation templates, a lightweight sales playbook page, a generator script to inject customer-specific values, and a legal sign-off checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Canonical SIG/CAIQ response (v1) stored in Drive and referenced in Console help
Three attestation templates written and reviewed by Legal and Security
A single-source-of-truth doc and a short runbook for Sales to attach to proposals
Generator script (Python) that replaces tenant/customer fields and emits PDF/email text
Stakeholder sign-offs: Security, Legal, Product, Sales enablement
Measure: reduce security questionnaire turnaround time for new enterprise deals by 30% in pilot
